llm.summary: The skill is coherently aimed at CellCog social-video generation, but users should review it because it sends creative prompts to an external service and recommends mutable, unpinned installation commands.

dimensions.detail: Use of python3, CELLCOG_API_KEY, networked CellCog SDK calls, and higher chat tier settings is proportionate for external AI video production, but users should avoid submitting secrets or regulated content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The setup section recommends npx, OpenClaw, plugin setup, and pip install -U commands without pinning a reviewed version or integrity check, so the installed dependency or companion skill can change after review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are mostly scoped to creating CellCog chats, but they do not plainly warn that prompts and referenced media or brand assets may be processed by CellCog outside the local environment.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains no scripts, background workers, memory writes, services, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, tool hijacking, destructive actions, or hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, metadata dependency on CellCog, API-key requirement, and examples all align around AI-generated Reels, TikToks, posts, stories, and carousels.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review CellCog's data-handling and content-rights terms before using this skill, especially for private campaigns, client materials, unpublished brand assets, or third-party media. Prefer pinned, reviewed package versions and install in a constrained environment with only the CELLCOG_API_KEY and files needed for the task.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: External prompt processing is expected for a CellCog generation skill, but the artifact under-discloses privacy, confidentiality, copyright, and asset-rights considerations.
[RP1] unexpected: Installing the companion CellCog skill or SDK is purpose-related, but using mutable unpinned install commands is not necessary for the purpose and creates supply-chain ambiguity.
[T08] unexpected: The static finding is supported by the setup instructions, especially the latest-version pip install guidance and unpinned skill install commands; the artifact itself does not contain an embedded malicious payload.
